title: The Office Energy Challenge · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short email (about 100 words) to your manager suggesting one way to save energy in your office. Use because, so, although, and may/might/can.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
